title: Full-Day Private tour through the Rocky Mountains
blurb:
**Some areas of this tour are not available between Nov. - May.**

This tour combines our scenic drive through the Wasatch Mountains tour, as well as our Drive Through Salt Lake’s Best Canyons tours

Travelers will get a comprehensive tour through the Rocky Mountains east of Salt Lake City. The tour features drives through canyons, views of lakes, waterfalls, mountain towns (including Park City), and beautiful forests. If you're wanting some of the best scenery Salt Lake City has to offer, this is the tour for you.
